TOPIC 9.1
Defining and 
Differentiating Parametric 
Equations

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-3.G 
Calculate derivatives of 
parametric functions.  
bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-3.G.1 
Methods for calculating derivatives of real-
valued functions can be extended to parametric 
functions. bc only

CHA-3.G.2 
For a curve defined parametrically, the value 

of d 

y over d x

 at a point on the curve is the slope of 

the line tangent to the curve at that point.d y

 over d x
the slope of the line tangent to a curve defined 
using parametric equations, can be determined 

by dividingd y

 over d t

 by d 

x over d t

 provided d 

x over d t

 does not 

equal zero. bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-3
Derivatives allow us to solve real-world problems involving rates of change.
